ntohs
Description
Convert the unsigned short integer from network byte order to host
byte order.
Syntax
ntohs
<
netshort
>
ntohs <netshort>
Convert the unsigned short integer from network byte order to host
byte order.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
netshort
1234
set
hostshort
[
ntohs
$netshort
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
,
GLOBAL_GTM
